text: { "name": "Brenna Ironhand", "age": 19, "facts": [ { "category": "appearance", "text": "She stands five feet seven inches tall, her build a compact blend of Lowlander stockiness and half-orc breadth, with shoulders wider than most women her age and a sturdy frame that speaks to years of hauling iron." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her skin is a muted grey-brown, smoother than a full orc's hide but rougher than a typical Lowlander's, with a faintly coarse texture visible when the light catches it." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her face carries a heavy brow ridge, less pronounced than a pure orc's but too defined to pass for human, set above dark brown eyes that give her an expression of permanent intensity." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "A single lower tusk juts from her left side, no more than a half-inch long, giving her profile a slight asymmetry." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her hair is coarse and dark brown, thick on her head and often pulled back with a leather cord to keep it from her face while working the forge." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "She is quick-tempered and prone to snapping when she feels disrespected, her orcish blood flaring hot in moments of frustration." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "Despite her temper, she is fiercely loyal to Master Aldric, her blacksmithing teacher, and considers his trust in her a point of pride she would never risk losing." }, { "category": "background", "text": "She grew up in the frontier town of Ashwick, a settlement of farmers, traders, and craftspeople at the edge of civilized territory, where half-blooded children are common but rarely welcomed warmly." } ] }

text: { "name": "Maren Ashwick", "age": 19, "facts": [ { "category": "appearance", "text": "She stands five feet seven inches tall, with a stocky yet not overly heavy frame that blends Lowlander compactness with half-orc breadth at the shoulders." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her skin is a muted grey-green, smoother than a full-blooded orc's but rougher than a Lowlander's, with a faintly grainy texture along her forearms and the bridge of her nose." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "She has dark brown hair, coarse and thick, that she keeps pulled back in a practical braid to keep it out of the forge's heat." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her ears are moderately pointed, sitting between the rounded shape of a Lowlander ear and the sharp taper of an orc's, and they twitch slightly when she's startled or angry." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "She has one small lower tusk, a half-inch nub jutting above her upper lip on the left side, while the right side has only a barely-visible bud beneath the gum." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her brow ridge is pronounced but not extreme, giving her face a strong-jawed angularity softened by the fullness of her human-inherited lips and the roundness of her cheekbones." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "She is quick-tempered and does not hesitate to voice her frustration, especially when a piece of metal refuses to cooperate, but she cools down faster than she heats up." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "She is fiercely loyal to her master, Aldric, and takes pride in his work as though it were her own, sometimes more so than he does." }, { "category": "background", "text": "She has been apprenticed to Aldric the blacksmith in the frontier town of Thornwall since she was fifteen, having walked there alone from a smaller settlement to learn the trade." } ] }
